The '''Gambler's Luck blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The '''Gambler's Luck''' strongly resembles the [https://www.imfdb.org/wiki/Blade_Runner#LAPD_2019_Blaster custom revolver] used by Rick Deckard in the original Blade Runner movie, albeit modified; it has an overall more stylized appearance with a second barrel, smaller cylinder, and partially copied-and-inverted forward section to give it a more unique silhouette. This is likely a nod to the fact Deckard was played by [[Harrison Ford]].
